svg.aria-label: Exfiltration attacks: 48/164 succeeded without Bouncer, 0/163 with it
svg.title: Exfiltration attacks: 48/164 succeeded without Bouncer, 0/163 with it
svg.desc: Exfiltration attacks: 48/164 succeeded without Bouncer, 0/163 with it. The cost: the 6 tasks that email or share a file went from 4/6 to 0/6 completed. Of the 48 cases where the attack succeeded without Bouncer, with Bouncer 44 had a send refused, 2 made no send attempt and 2 have no result. One model (openai/gpt-4o-mini), one fixed non-adaptive attack template (important_instructions), one trial per case. Refused includes 7 calls held for approval with no human present.
svg.text: The cost: the 6 tasks that email or share a file went from 4/6 to 0/6 completed.
